script_text: Pisces, Neptune is about to rewrite your entire week. Monday through Wednesday, the Sun in late Taurus squares your 5th House, stirring creative tension while Mercury in Gemini sextiles your 7th House, sharpening conversations with partners. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 5th House. The mid-week turning point hits Thursday when Jupiter in Cancer opposes your Sun from the 7th House, forcing a truth you've been avoiding in love. Thursday through Sunday, Neptune stations direct in Aries, trining your 9th House and unlocking a long-distance opportunity or spiritual breakthrough. Saturday is your worst day as Mars in Aries squares your 4th House, stirring domestic conflict. Career money peaks Friday when a Venus-Jupiter trine hits your 10th and 2nd Houses. Breathe before you speak during Thursday's opposition. Follow for daily updates.
